node.title: Re^3: Sorry.. Same problem but some progress!
node.author: marto
node.doctext: Please, take a step back. We're happy to help, but it gets confusing in such cases. Take a moment to describe the situation, I'd guess you're migrating something to a new instance of Strawberry Perl, and having some issues. Even if it seems like a large frustrating problem, taking the time to describe what is going on can be fruitful. You don't have to post your whole application, however if you are moving something with a list of dependencies then you're going to have to satisfy those. You may want to take a look at [metamod://Module::ScanDeps], which ships with the program [https://metacpan.org/pod/distribution/Module-ScanDeps/script/scandeps.pl|scandeps.pl] which you can use to try and determine dependencies.
